# bioconductor-readqpcr

## Overview

Use the Bioconductor R package **ReadqPCR** for: The package provides functions to read raw RT-qPCR data of different platforms.

## Installation

```r
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("ReadqPCR")
```
